parameters.description:
`msg-to-elks-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your 46elks destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own 46elks destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional 46elks destinations bound per enrollment.

46elks delivers SMS through your own 46elks account — sign up and configure a sender at 46elks.com. Set ELKS_SMS_FROM to the phone number or approved alphanumeric sender name your account is authorized to send from, and ELKS_SMS_TO to the recipient's phone number, ideally in E.164 format.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment 46elks destinations, direct
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own 46elks destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

basic_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's ELKS_SMS_BASIC value (same format as ELKS_SMS_BASIC)

from_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's ELKS_SMS_FROM value (same format as ELKS_SMS_FROM)

to_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's ELKS_SMS_TO value (same format as ELKS_SMS_TO)
